_comment: Maps Claude Code hook events -> Codex hook events. Used by translate.js when porting hooks.json. VERIFIED 2026-07-22 against primary Codex docs (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). Codex supports exactly 10 hook events, all identically named to their Claude Code counterparts: SessionStart, SubagentStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStop, Stop. This corrects the 2026-04-24 version of this file, which wrongly dropped SubagentStop/PreCompact and never had a PostCompact/SubagentStart/PermissionRequest entry at all -- those assumptions were unverified against primary docs.

PreToolUse.note: Codex fires for Bash, apply_patch, MCP tool calls. ApplyPatchHandler bug exists per openai/codex#16732.

PermissionRequest.note: Fires when Codex asks the user to approve a tool call. Previously only reached the Codex output via translateHooks' no-mapping passthrough path -- now explicit.

SubagentStart.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- corrects the prior assumption that Codex has no per-subagent lifecycle events. Revives Mission Control's subagent-start-tracker.js writer on Codex.

SubagentStop.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- corrects the prior 'drop' status (which assumed subagent results return to the parent context with no separate stop event). Revives Mission Control's agent-run-logger.js writer (agent-runs / subagent-costs) on Codex.

PreCompact.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- corrects the prior 'drop' status.

PostCompact.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- new entry; this map previously had no PostCompact row at all.

SessionEnd.note: NOT in Codex's 10-event hook surface -- corrects the prior (unverified) assumption that Codex has a SessionEnd event.

Notification.note: No Codex equivalent. macOS notification handlers must move to launchd or a separate daemon.

schema_compat.command_format: Both use { type: 'command', command: '<path>' } -- JSON identical.
schema_compat.matcher_field: Both support regex matcher. Use '*' or omit for all events.
schema_compat.stdin_payload: Both pipe JSON to stdin. Field names mostly match. Verify per-event schema in Codex hooks reference.
schema_compat.env_vars: Codex plugin hook commands receive PLUGIN_ROOT + PLUGIN_DATA (native) AND CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA ('for compatibility with existing plugin hooks' -- learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT is NOT a real Codex variable; a prior version of this adapter rewrote hook/skill bodies to reference it, which broke every generated hook and skill instruction that touched the plugin root. Fixed 2026-07-22: hook commands and skill bodies now keep ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} verbatim.
schema_compat.async_handlers: A handler with "async": true is parsed by Codex but skipped ('asynchronous command hooks aren't supported yet'). translate.js strips the async flag so the handler still runs, synchronously, instead of being silently dropped.
